piles.title: Local sensing and control
core_questions: Which loop must remain local and deterministic?
How are tracks, controller health, and handoffs preserved when links degrade?
What information may a model interpret without owning control authority?
irreducible_constraints: Fast controller and safety loops cannot depend on remote inference.
Track identity, event time, freshness, and handoff provenance must survive transport changes.
A common operating picture may consume local state without becoming the local control loop.

donors.title: Cooperative sensing, handoff, and contested-communications review

piles.title: Readiness and sustainment
core_questions: Does the administrative record match physical availability?
Which condition, allocation, maintenance, due-in, or movement record is the actual blocker?
What minimum dirty-data handshake can an operational user provide?
irreducible_constraints: On-hand quantity cannot establish serviceability by itself.
Evidence gaps must remain visible instead of being filled by model narration.
The intake path must tolerate ordinary spreadsheets, screenshots, and incomplete exports.

donors.title: Inventory, maintenance, and due-in acceptance demo

piles.title: People, communications, and attention
core_questions: Which named human currently holds the role, mandate, and decision?
What changed, who acknowledged it, and what must survive a shift or device transition?
How should the node compress many streams into a bounded human decision object?
irreducible_constraints: Human presence, role, acknowledgment, and disposition must be attributable.
A role-specific aperture may filter state but may not rewrite shared truth.
The user must be returned to the decision surface rather than a transcript.

donors.title: Sanitized operator-presence, lease, and reconciliation shape
Multi-arm assistant with blocking critic and human correction

piles.title: Platform sovereignty and substitution
core_questions: Can compute, boot, RF, update, evidence, and recovery providers be replaced independently?
Does a head or runtime change create a new treatment without creating a new mission history?
Can the system recover after the preferred vendor, adapter, or accelerator disappears?
irreducible_constraints: A component swap must not become a program restart.
Hardware, runtime, model, adapter, and mission identities remain distinct.
The surviving system must retain a neutral export, rollback, and verification route.

donors.title: Sanitized compute, boot, RF, update, and evidence sovereignty analysis
AXM System Fabric topology and recovery contracts
Hardware identity, attestation, and selective-disclosure fixtures

piles.title: Evidence, provenance, and qualification
core_questions: Which exact bytes, model, runtime, hardware, and acceptance authority produced the result?
Can the current state and claim be reconstructed without the original model or provider?
Does an error remain infrastructure evidence rather than becoming a capability score?
irreducible_constraints: Evidence must remain source-bound, content-addressed, and independently verifiable.
Model identity, runtime identity, hardware identity, and capability remain separate ledgers.
No aggregate score may conceal a failed authority, custody, or survival gate.

piles.title: Circulation, orchestration, and recovery
core_questions: How does accepted work survive interruption, process death, and head replacement?
Which resource should carry a task without pretending separate GPUs share memory?
How are approvals, effects, outcomes, and compensation preserved across retries?
irreducible_constraints: Work state must be durable and reconstructable outside a model session.
Side effects require idempotency and explicit outcome receipts.
Resource placement must expose CPU spill, link limits, throttling, and worker loss.
